players.product: GPU cloud / AI compute capacity (NVIDIA GB300 NVL72)

connects_to.relationship: 50-MW AI compute deployment on NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 systems

contracts.signal: ChronoScale 8-K: ChronoScale and Microsoft agreed to extend the term of their strategic partnership for the planned 50 MW AI compute deployment in North America from two years to three years; the deployment will feature NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 systems with advanced liquid cooling, high-performance networking and storage.
